title: 2028 Olympic torch relay to begin in Atlanta ahead of Los Angeles Games
summary: Atlanta will be the first stop in the United States for the Olympic flame after it arrives from Greece ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games, officials announced on Tuesday (September 29).
